coroutine.why: Named language construct (coroutines in Python, Kotlin, C++20, Go-style manuals). Plural alias is fine.

destructuring.why: Named feature in JS, Python and Rust manuals. Plausibly known by many programmers.

preprocessor macro.why: C standard construct (C11 6.10). Aliases 'macros' and 'macro' are inflection or a generic form. 'C macros' is a qualified binding, acceptable.

dynamic typing.why: Named typing discipline that language manuals and papers use by name. Common among programmers.

pointers.why: Core named construct in C and C++ manuals. Off-by-one tier fits; 'pointer' is inflection, 'raw pointers' is a Rust/C++ kind.

exception handling.why: Named language feature in every major language manual. 'try catch' is a keyword binding of the same feature, so it's an alias.

struct.why: Named construct in the C standard and in Rust and Go manuals. 'structs' is inflection; 'structure' is a synonym.

const.why: Named qualifier in C, C++ and JS manuals. Alias 'final' is a common English word and too generic; drop it. 'constants' names a different concept, so it's questionable as an alias.

goto.why: Named construct in C and Go manuals. 'goto statement' is a plain binding.

function-like macro.why: Named C standard term (C11 6.10.3), a kind of preprocessor macro. Specialist tier fits.

decorators.why: Named Python feature (PEP 318). 'decorator' is inflection; 'function decorators' is a qualified binding.

lambda.why: Named construct in Python, Java and C++ manuals. 'lambda expression' and 'lambdas' are phrasing variants; 'anonymous function' is a generic name for the same kind.

iterator.why: Named construct in C++, Python and Java manuals. Plural alias is inflection.

default arguments.why: Named feature in C++, Python and Kotlin manuals. 'default parameters' is a synonym. 'default values' is too generic and should be dropped.

tuple.why: Named construct in Python and other language manuals. Plural alias is inflection.

list comprehension.why: Named Python feature (PEP 202). Plural alias is inflection.

multithreading.why: Named language capability in Java and other manuals, though it is a broad concept. The alias 'threads' names a different kind and should be dropped.

dictionary comprehension.why: Named Python feature. 'dict comprehension' is an abbreviation of a kept entry, and the plural is inflection.

reflection.why: Named capability in Java, C# and Go manuals. 'runtime reflection' is a qualified binding. 'introspection' is looser and arguably a different concept, so it's questionable as an alias.

set comprehension.why: Named Python feature (PEP 274 era). Plural alias is inflection.
